desc: Parse input; store blocked intervals (already sorted, non-overlapping, with gaps).
Design compact reachable-set representation: trailing B-bit window `bits` (bit k = reach(cur−k)); proved saturation: nonempty window + free gap > B²+B ⇒ full window reachable (A < B).
Design block crossing: advance_free(L−1), then shift bits left by (R−L+1) to zero blocked positions, continue; final advance_free(N) and test bit 0.
Handle A == B special case: reachable iff (N−1) % A == 0 and no block contains a position ≡ 1 (mod A).
Implement in Python with sys.stdin, print Yes/No.

Verify correctness: hand-trace samples; brute-force cross-check on small random cases (small N, random blocks/A/B) against the window+saturation algorithm, especially saturation boundary, gap < B between blocks, A=B=1, M=0.
